events.action: {"message": "Fixed the defect in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/kernel/mailbox.c` where `mbox_message_data_check()` unconditionally called `k_mbox_data_get(rx_msg, buffer)` due to an `if (1)` condition instead of `if (buffer != NULL)`. When `buffer` was `NULL` (deferred data retrieval), `k_mbox_data_get` discarded the message and set `rx_msg->size = 0` prematurely. Changing the condition to `if (buffer != NULL)` restores the intended behavior and all 18 tests in `mbox_api` pass.", "kind": "FinishAction"}
